column1: REQ-FUN-01 Patient Registration
column27:
*User Story:*

 As a new patient, I want to create an account using my personal details so that I can log in and book appointments.

 *Functional Specifications:* 

* Input Fields: Full Name, Phone Number, Email Address, Date of Birth, Gender, Password, Confirm Password. 

* Full Name: Alphabetic characters and spaces only. Min 3, Max 50 chars. 

* Email Address: Standard RFC 5322 format ([user@domain.com|mailto:user@domain.com]). Must be unique. 

* Phone Number: Exactly 11 digits starting with Egyptian carrier prefixes (010, 011, 012, 015). Must be unique. 

* Date of Birth: Past date only. Age must be ≥ 18 years relative to system date.

* Password: Min 8, Max 20 chars; ≥ 1 uppercase, ≥ 1 lowercase, ≥ 1 digit, and ≥ 1 special character (!@#$%^&*).

* Confirm Password: Must match Password field exactly. 

*Validation / Exception Handling:* 

* Invalid inputs trigger immediate inline errors and block form submission.

* All types of possible invalid email
* *Missing At-Sign*: {{userdomain.com}} lacks the required {{@}} symbol separating the local part and the domain.
* *Multiple At-Signs*: {{user@@domain.com}} or {{user@sub@domain.com}} contains more than one unquoted {{@}} symbol.
* *Consecutive Dots*: {{user..name@domain.com}} or {{user@domain..com}} uses repeating dots, which violate standard specifications.
* *Leading or Trailing Dots*: {{.user@domain.com}} or {{user.@domain.com}} starts or ends the local part with a dot outside of quoted strings.
* *Spaces in Wrong Places*: {{user @domain.com}} or {{user@ domain.com}} includes illegal unquoted whitespace within the address structure.
* *Missing Parts*: {{@domain.com}} (missing local part) or {{user@}} (missing domain part).
* *Exceeded Length Limits*: Local parts longer than 64 characters or total lengths exceeding 320 characters.

* Beneficiary: Selecting “Booking for Someone Else” requires Beneficiary Name (Alpha, 3-50 chars) and Beneficiary Phone (11-digit EG format).
* Promo Input: Up to 15 chars; Alphanumeric + Hyphens. Input triggers trim and uppercase normalization. 
* SAVE10: Deducts 10% from total fee.
* FLAT50: Deducts 50 EGP flat rate.
* BEST-QA: Deducts 100% (Total = 0 EGP).

 *Validation / Exception Handling:* 

* BEST-QA message: “Discount Applied! You are officially the best QA team. ” 
* Unrecognized codes trigger: “Invalid or expired promo code.” 
* Promo code cannot be applied more than once per booking session. 
* Total fee after discount cannot fall below 0 EGP.

column27:
As a logged-in patient, i want to select a payment method and finalize my booking to receive a confirmed booking receipt.


1. The patient can select either pay at clinic (Cash) or Credit Card 
2. If Credit Card is selected, the card number must contain exactly 16 numeric digits.

3.The expiry date must be in MM/YY format and must not be earlier than the current month/year.

4.The CVV must contain exactly 3 numeric digits.

5.When the transaction is finalized, the selected slot changes from Availabe to Booked.

6.The system generates a unique 8-character booking reference ID .

7.The booking receipt displays the booking ID, doctor, date/time, address, total paid, and payment method.
